title: Add option to remove PM and AM from digital clock widget
line: The Digital Clock has a new "Show AM/PM" option, so a 12-hour clock can show 10:09 instead of 10:09 PM.
explanation: The Digital Clock's time display only offered 12-hour, 24-hour or the region default, and 12-hour time always ended with AM/PM. Qt has no 12-hour hour token without AM/PM (a bare h shows 24-hour time), so there was no way to get 10:09 instead of 10:09 PM. The change adds a "Show AM/PM" checkbox below Time display, enabled only when the clock is in 12-hour time. When it is unchecked, the panel label formats the time as usual and drops the AM/PM text from the end, and the size calculation leaves it out too.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: add option to hide AM/PM in 12-hour mode

The clock could only show 12-hour time with AM/PM after it, which takes
space in the panel. Add a "Show AM/PM" checkbox below the time display
option; when unchecked, the panel shows the 12-hour time without it.

BUG: 507156
